info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Subscribes-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Subscriptions API enables users to subscribe to weather alerts relevant to their interests or location. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a list of all current subscriptions, providing insight into active alerts for individual users. Typical consumers of this API include weather service applications and alert management systems seeking to enhance user engagement with real-time weather information. By utilizing this API, developers can ensure that users stay informed about critical weather conditions that may impact their safety and decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to subscribe to receive alerts notifications based on their preferences. Users can specify the types of alerts they wish to receive and manage their subscription effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to subscribe to alerts. It includes the necessary parameters and configurations required to establish the subscription successfully.

200.description: The subscription request was successfully processed, and the client is now subscribed to alerts.

ListWeatherAlertsSubscribesRequest.description: The request body for subscribing to alerts. This schema is used to specify the necessary details in JSON format.
